projectionRules.rule: PUB derives from SSOT; engineering truth remains in the referenced SSOT documents.
Applicability is mandatory and bound to ACT/CCT/PCT for eWTW baseline MSN-001..050.
System-owned lightning and weather-radar content is referenced by dmRef and not duplicated into this structural publication layer.

section.title: Scope
section.para: This module addresses forward-fuselage skin and frame repair intent for the forward barrel branch named in the section SSOT.

The radome is not a substitute pressure-shell skin/frame case and remains outside the specific repair content of this module; radome structural constraints are handled only as referenced context from the radome SSOT.

section.title: Repair constraints
section.para: Preserve load paths across skin panels, stringers, frames, and the forward production join splice to the centre section.
Do not compromise adjacent door, window, equipment-bay, or pressure-bulkhead interfaces when blending or restoring local skin/frame damage.

warning.para: TBD: The current SSOT does not define patch schemes, fastener patterns, blend limits, or dimensional tolerances for forward-barrel skin/frame repair. Add those values from the detailed barrel leaf documents when available.
